topics.label: Juicing & JAB Program
suggestedPrompts: How do I get started with juicing?
replies: Juicing for Authentic Balance (JAB) is Misty’s core juicing methodology — start with Foundations / Mindset setup, then build into daily rituals. Always include a leafy green when you can for maximum nutrients.
Welcome to JAB energy! Complete topics in order, check in weekly, and keep your juicer setup simple so the habit sticks. Progress over perfection, bestie.
If you’re new to juicing, begin with Book 1: The Foundation, watch the welcome overview, then try a simple green glow or beet & carrot juice from the recipes section.

topics.label: Authentic Balance & Mindset
replies: Authentic balance isn’t about perfection — it’s about consistency and grace. Misty’s approach is finding what works for your unique body, mind, and life season.
You are not starting over. You are starting from experience. Revisit your ‘why’ from Module 1 and let that guide today’s small step.
Your body is listening to every word you speak — so speak kindly. Choose one Authentic pillar focus today and honor it without pressure.

topics.label: Pillars & Life Areas
suggestedPrompts: Which pillar should I focus on?
replies: Authentic Balance has seven pillars: Body, Brain, Becoming, Behavior, Bonding, Beauty, and Business. You pick a starting pillar in onboarding so your dashboard and community match your focus.
Authentic Body is about physical health, energy, and vitality — meals, hydration, juicing, and daily tracking live here. Authentic Business focuses on leadership, systems, and growth.
Your pillar isn’t a box — it’s your entry point. You can grow into other pillars over time as Misty’s programs and communities expand with you.

topics.label: Modules, Lessons & Progress
suggestedPrompts: What should I do in Module 1?
Where do I start in my program?
replies: In JAB, Foundations comes first (Mindset setup with books, welcome video, and getting-started guides). Implementation / Daily rituals unlocks after the timed milestone — stay consistent through the early days.
Module 1 energy looks like Hydration & Energy and Setting Your Why. Module 2 goes deeper with Understanding Your Gut and Building Daily Rituals. Take them in order when you can.
Treat your program like a journey: Pillar → Program → Modules → Sections → Lessons. Finish today’s lesson, log your check-in, then come back tomorrow. Small daily steps create the life you want.

topics.label: Hydration & Energy
suggestedPrompts: Have I been drinking enough water?
replies: Hydration is key for Authentic Body energy! Aim for your daily water goal — those 8 glasses matter. Check your dashboard tracker and sip steadily through the day.
Low energy often starts with low water. Pair hydration with your juicing ritual and you’ll feel the difference. You’ve got this.
Bestie tip: set gentle reminders, log each glass, and celebrate consistency — not perfection.

topics.label: Meals, Recipes & Food Choices
suggestedPrompts: Is pizza okay on the program?
replies: Lean into whole, vibrant foods — think zucchini noodles, turmeric cauliflower bowls, cucumber salads, chia pudding, and green juices from the Recipes section. Log what you eat so we can stay honest together.
Heavy pasta, pizza, packaged, or fried foods can pull you off Authentic Body protocol. If that showed up today, no shame — choose a lighter next meal and get back on track.
Hungry for ideas? Try Anti-Inflammatory Green Glow Juice, Beet & Carrot Detox Juice, or High-Protein Overnight Oats. Browse Recipes by Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner, Snack, or Juice.

topics.label: Daily Rituals & Tracking
suggestedPrompts: Help me build a daily ritual
replies: Daily rituals are where Authentic Behavior meets Authentic Body — juice or hydrate, log meals, move with intention, and journal one honest line. Consistency beats intensity.
Open your dashboard: meals, hydration, progress, weight, and journaling are there to keep you accountable. One check-in today is a win.
If you missed a day, you’re not behind — you’re practicing. Restart with the smallest ritual you can keep for the next 7 days.

topics.label: Family, Community & Bonding
suggestedPrompts: How do I involve my family?
replies: Authentic Bonding matters here — you’re not meant to do this alone. Join your pillar community, share wins, and let your people cheer you on.
Authentic Balance is for your unique body and family. Invite them into simple rituals — a shared juice, a walk, or logging water together.
Feeling unsupported? Check Community for your pillar space and events. Connection is part of the methodology, not an extra.

topics.label: Authentic Business & Leadership
suggestedPrompts: I’m on the business pillar — where do I start?
replies: Authentic Business focuses on leadership, systems, and enterprise growth. Your business dashboard highlights consulting needs, automation, and next steps from onboarding.
Clarify your model, automate what you can, and invest in premium consulting when you’re ready. Assessment → entry product → coaching → programs → ongoing growth.
Affiliates can earn by referring members to Authentic Balance — entry books, upgrades, programs, and challenges. Ask Admin or Affiliate Help if you’re building that lane.

topics.label: Motivation & Accountability
replies: Progress not perfection. You’re doing amazing on your journey — pick one tiny action (water, a juice, or a 5-minute lesson) and do it now.
When consistency wobbles, return to your why, your pillar, and today’s ritual. Misty’s challenges and coaching exist for deeper accountability when you’re ready.
Small daily steps create the life you want. I’m here as your Authentic Bestie — ask me about juicing, meals, hydration, modules, or mindset anytime.

topics.label: Books, Membership & Getting Started
suggestedPrompts: What’s included in the book package?
replies: The $77 JAB Book Series unlocks all 4 Authentic Balance books (read & listen), basic self-guided tools for your pillar, Authentic Bestie, and your pillar community.
Start with onboarding: choose your pillar, answer a few questions, then enter through the book package. From there, Explore Learn / Programs for JAB content.
Books get you in the door. Structured lessons, personalized coaching, and Misty challenges unlock with premium coaching upgrades when you’re ready for the next level.
